# X News Brief Skill — 4 Files Còn Lại

Tiếp tục với output-template.md, examples.md, thefeed-guide.md, prioritization.md.

---

## File 3: `x-news-brief/output-template.md`

```markdown
# Output Template — X News Brief

Standard template for all crypto + tech briefings.

---

## Template Structure

```
🌅 [Session Icon + Name] Brief — [Day], [Date]

🔥 Top 2-5 stories
• [Story 1 title] — [1-line summary] ([views])
• [Story 2 title] — [1-line summary] ([views])
• [Story 3 title] — [1-line summary] ([views])

🧠 Narrative pulse
Crypto: [1-2 sentences về crypto trends]
Tech: [1-2 sentences về tech trends]

📌 Đáng đọc (7-10 items)

Crypto:
• [Item 1] — [Why interesting] [Link]
• [Item 2] — [Why interesting] [Link]
• [Item 3] — [Why interesting] [Link]

Tech:
• [Item 1] — [Why interesting] [Link]
• [Item 2] — [Why interesting] [Link]
• [Item 3] — [Why interesting] [Link]

TL;DR: [1 dòng tóm tắt covering both categories]
```

---

## Session Icons & Names

| Session | Icon | Time (ICT) | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Morning | ☀️ | 7:00 | Overnight + Asia morning |
| Midday | 🌤️ | 13:00 | US morning news |
| Wrap | 🌙 | 21:00 | US afternoon + day recap |

---

## Section Guidelines

### 🔥 Top Stories (2-5 items)

**Purpose:** Highlight most important developments (breaking + high engagement)

**Selection criteria:**
- All breaking news (Tier 1)
- Highest engagement items (Tier 2)
- Flexible mix (not forced 50/50)

**Format per item:**
```
• [Author/Source]: [Summary] — [Additional context] ([views])
```

**Example:**
```
• Vitalik: Ethereum L2s now process 10x mainnet TPS — Major scaling milestone (2.3M)
• OpenAI: GPT-5 training complete, release Q3 — Multimodal capabilities (1.8M)
```

**Length:** 1 line per story, max 280 characters

---

### 🧠 Narrative Pulse (2 sections)

**Purpose:** Synthesize broader trends in each category

**Crypto section (1-2 sentences):**
- Dominant theme or topic
- Emerging trends
- Sentiment shift

**Tech section (1-2 sentences):**
- Dominant theme or topic
- Product launches or updates
- Industry movement

**Format:**
```
Crypto: [Sentence 1 about dominant theme]. [Sentence 2 about trend or sentiment].
Tech: [Sentence 1 about dominant theme]. [Sentence 2 about launches or movement].
```

**Example:**
```
Crypto: DeFi yields surge as ETH staking unlocks approach. Solana ecosystem sees renewed developer activity with 3 major protocol launches.
Tech: AI agents dominate discussion with 5 new launches today. Open-source models gaining traction as companies seek cost reduction.
```

**Tone:** Informative, neutral, no speculation

---

### 📌 Đáng Đọc (7-10 items, 50/50 split)

**Purpose:** Curated list of interesting items worth reading

**Crypto section (3-5 items):**
- High engagement not in top stories
- Interesting narrative items
- Emerging topics

**Tech section (3-5 items):**
- High engagement not in top stories
- Product launches
- Developer tools or updates

**Format per item:**
```
• [Title/Summary] — [Why interesting] [Link]
```

**"Why interesting" patterns:**
- "Breaking news"
- "High engagement (X%)"
- "Viral momentum"
- "Emerging topic"
- "Unexpected take from [credible source]"
- "Major launch"
- "Developer tool"

**Example:**
```
Crypto:
• Uniswap V4 hooks enable custom AMM logic — Major DeFi innovation [Link]
• Solana fees drop 90% after network upgrade — High engagement (12.3%) [Link]
• Vitalik proposes new EIP for account abstraction — Emerging topic [Link]

Tech:
• Claude launches self-hosted sandboxes — Developer tool [Link]
• Gemini Omni creates video from text — Major launch [Link]
• Karpathy joins Anthropic — Breaking news [Link]
```

**Length:** 1 line per item, max 200 characters

---

### TL;DR (1 line)

**Purpose:** Ultra-concise summary of entire brief

**Format:**
```
[X] breaking, [Y] crypto + [Z] tech updates. [Crypto theme]. [Tech theme].
```

**Example:**
```
2 breaking, 15 crypto + 12 tech updates. DeFi yields surge on ETH unlock. AI agents dominate launches.
```

**Length:** Max 280 characters

---

## Formatting Rules

### Links
- Use Markdown format: `[Link](https://...)`
- Always include full URL
- Test links before sending

### Numbers
- Views: Format as "1.2M" or "500K"
- Percentages: 1 decimal place "12.3%"
- Counts: Use actual numbers "15 crypto"

### Emphasis
- **Bold:** Not used (Telegram doesn't support in all clients)
- *Italic:* Not used
- Emoji: Section markers only (🔥🧠📌)

### Line Breaks
- 1 blank line between sections
- No blank lines within sections
- Consistent spacing

---

## CT Voice Guidelines

**Tone:** Casual, informative, no hype

**Slang usage:**
- Max 1-2 terms per brief
- Prefer: ser, alpha, based
- Avoid: wagmi, LFG, degen (too casual for news)

**Placement:**
- Narrative pulse: "ser, [insight]"
- Đáng đọc: "alpha on [topic]"
- TL;DR: No slang

**Example with slang:**
```
Crypto: DeFi yields surge, ser. ETH staking unlocks driving capital rotation.
```

**Example without slang (preferred for news):**
```
Crypto: DeFi yields surge as ETH staking unlocks approach. Capital rotation accelerating.
```

**Recommendation:** Minimal slang (0-1 per brief) for news briefing.

---

## Edge Cases

### No new items
```
☀️ Morning Brief — Monday, 19 May 2026

No new crypto/tech news since last check (7:00 AM).

Last item: 2026-05-19 06:45:00 ICT
```

### One category unavailable
```
☀️ Morning Brief — Monday, 19 May 2026

⚠️ Tech news unavailable this run.

🔥 Top 3 stories (Crypto only)
[... crypto stories ...]

🧠 Narrative pulse
Crypto: [narrative]
Tech: Unavailable

📌 Đáng đọc (5 items, Crypto only)
[... crypto items ...]

TL;DR: 1 breaking, 8 crypto updates. [Crypto theme].
```

### Extreme breaking news (>5 items)
```
🔥 Top 7 stories (6 breaking)
• [Breaking 1] — [summary] ([views])
• [Breaking 2] — [summary] ([views])
• [Breaking 3] — [summary] ([views])
• [Breaking 4] — [summary] ([views])
• [Breaking 5] — [summary] ([views])
• [Breaking 6] — [summary] ([views])
• [High engagement 1] — [summary] ([views])
```

**Note:** Flexible 2-5 becomes 6-7 if many breaking items.

---

## Quality Checklist

Before sending, verify:

**Content:**
- [ ] All items newer than last run
- [ ] Breaking news included (if any)
- [ ] Top stories 2-5 (flexible)
- [ ] Đáng đọc 7-10 (50/50 split)
- [ ] Narrative pulse separate (Crypto + Tech)
- [ ] TL;DR covers both categories

**Format:**
- [ ] Session icon correct
- [ ] Date/day correct
- [ ] Sections clearly separated
- [ ] All links working
- [ ] Numbers formatted consistently
- [ ] No typos

**Tone:**
- [ ] Informative, not hype
- [ ] Minimal slang (0-1 terms)
- [ ] No speculation
- [ ] Professional but casual

---

**Last updated:** 2026-05-19
```

```

🔥 Top 4 stories
• Watcher.Guru: Japan recognizes foreign crypto stablecoins as legal payments from June 1 — Major regulatory shift (551K)

• MTS: Karpathy joins Anthropic — Former OpenAI lead moves to Claude team (847K)
• Claude: Self-hosted sandboxes now in beta — Developers can run code locally (1.5M)

🧠 Narrative pulse
Crypto: Regulatory clarity in Asia driving institutional adoption. Japan's stablecoin move follows Singapore's framework. DeFi protocols preparing for Asian market expansion.
Tech: AI safety investments accelerate as Hassabis backs Anthropic. Developer tools focus intensifies with Claude sandboxes and Gemini Omni video model launches.

📌 Đáng đọc (8 items)

Crypto:
• Solana fees drop 90% after network upgrade — High engagement (12.3%) [Link]
• Uniswap V4 hooks enable custom AMM logic — Major DeFi innovation [Link]
• Vitalik proposes new EIP for account abstraction — Emerging topic [Link]
• Base surpasses Arbitrum in daily transactions — L2 competition heats up [Link]

Tech:
• Logan announces Gemini Omni video model — Create videos from text prompts [Link]

• Rushi: AI reaction unlike early internet days — Thoughtful take on adoption curve [Link]

TL;DR: 2 breaking, 12 crypto + 10 tech updates. Asia leads crypto regulation. AI safety and developer tools dominate tech.

## Pattern Summary

| Session | Typical Top Stories | Typical Đáng Đọc | Tone |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Morning** | 3-5 (overnight breaking) | 8-10 (balanced) | Fresh, anticipatory |
| **Midday** | 3-5 (US morning news) | 8-10 (balanced) | Active, developing |
| **Wrap** | 2-4 (day recap) | 6-8 (lighter) | Reflective, summary |

**Breaking news distribution:**
- Morning: 1-2 breaking (overnight events)
- Midday: 0-2 breaking (US morning)
- Wrap: 0-1 breaking (day-end)

**Category balance:**
- Top stories: Flexible (highest priority wins)
- Đáng đọc: 50/50 split maintained
- Narrative: Always separate

## File 5: `x-news-brief/references/thefeed-guide.md`

```markdown
# Reference — Using thefeed.today

Guide to extracting data from thefeed.today for news briefing.

---

## Site Overview

**URL:** https://thefeed.today/

**Purpose:** Real-time X (Twitter) trends aggregator

**Key features:**
- Pre-summarized tweets (1-line per item)
- Category filters (Crypto, Tech, News, etc.)
- Engagement metrics (views, likes, engagement rate)
- Breaking news tags
- No authentication required
- No rate limits

---

## Page Structure

### Main Feed

**Layout:**
```
[Header with filters]
[Feed items - vertical list]
[Lazy load on scroll]
```

**Feed item structure:**
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [Avatar] [Author Name]              │
│ [Summary text]                      │
│ [Category tag] [Time ago]           │
│ [Views] [Engagement %] [Link]       │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Category Filters

**Available filters:**
- All (default)
- Crypto
- Tech
- News
- Sports
- Entertainment
- Politics
- General

**For this skill, use:**
- Crypto
- Tech

---

## Data Extraction

### Item Components

**1. Author/Source**
- Location: `.item-title` or `[data-author]`
- Format: "Author Name" or "@handle"
- Example: "Vitalik Buterin" or "@VitalikButerin"

**2. Summary**
- Location: `.item-summary` or `[data-summary]`
- Format: 1-line text (pre-summarized by thefeed)
- Example: "Ethereum L2s now process 10x mainnet TPS"

**3. Views**
- Location: `.views-count` or `[data-views]`
- Format: "1.2M" or "500K" or "1234"
- Parse: Convert to integer

**4. Likes**
- Location: `.likes-count` or `[data-likes]`
- Format: "12.5K" or "1234"
- Parse: Convert to integer

**5. Engagement Rate**
- Location: `.engagement-rate` or calculate from likes/views
- Format: "12.3%" or calculate
- Parse: Float percentage

**6. Link**
- Location: `a.item-link` href attribute
- Format: Full X.com URL
- Example: "https://x.com/VitalikButerin/status/..."

**7. Timestamp**
- Location: `.timestamp` or `[data-time]`
- Format: Relative time ("2h ago", "1d ago", "just now")
- Parse: Convert to datetime

**8. Breaking Tag**
- Location: `.breaking-tag` or text contains "Breaking"
- Format: Boolean (present or not)
- Parse: True if tag exists

**9. Category**
- Location: `.category-tag` or filter context
- Format: "Crypto" or "Tech"
- Parse: String (set by which filter was active)

---

## Extraction Strategy

### Step 1: Navigate to site

```python
page.goto("https://thefeed.today/")
page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
```

### Step 2: Apply filter

**Crypto:**
```python
crypto_button = page.locator('button:has-text("Crypto")')
crypto_button.click()
page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
```

**Tech:**
```python
tech_button = page.locator('button:has-text("Tech")')
tech_button.click()
page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
```

### Step 3: Scroll to load items

```python
for i in range(3):
    page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)")
    page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
```

**Why 3 scrolls:**
- Each scroll loads ~7-10 items
- 3 scrolls = ~20-30 items
- Sufficient for top news

### Step 4: Extract items

```python
items = page.locator('[data-testid="feed-item"]').all()

for item in items[:20]:
    # Extract data (see Item Components above)
    pass
```

---

## Selector Reference

**Note:** Selectors may change. Adjust based on actual HTML.

**Common selectors:**
```python
# Feed items
'[data-testid="feed-item"]'
'.feed-item'
'article'

# Author
'.item-title'
'[data-author]'
'.author-name'

# Summary
'.item-summary'
'[data-summary]'
'.summary-text'

# Metrics
'.views-count'
'.likes-count'
'.engagement-rate'

# Link
'a.item-link'
'[data-link]'

# Timestamp
'.timestamp'
'[data-time]'
'.time-ago'

# Breaking tag
'.breaking-tag'
'.badge-breaking'
```

---

## Parsing Helpers

### Parse Views/Likes

```python
def parse_number(text):
    """
    Parse formatted numbers.
    
    Examples:
        "1.2M" → 1200000
        "500K" → 500000
        "1,234" → 1234
    """
    text = text.replace(',', '').strip()
    
    if 'M' in text:
        return int(float(text.replace('M', '')) * 1_000_000)
    elif 'K' in text:
        return int(float(text.replace('K', '')) * 1_000)
    else:
        return int(text)
```

### Parse Timestamp

```python
def parse_timestamp(text):
    """
    Parse relative time to datetime.
    
    Examples:
        "just now" → now
        "2h ago" → now - 2 hours
        "1d ago" → now - 1 day
    """
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    text = text.lower().strip()
    
    if 'just now' in text:
        return now
    elif 'h ago' in text:
        hours = int(text.split('h')[0].strip())
        return now - timedelta(hours=hours)
    elif 'd ago' in text:
        days = int(text.split('d')[0].strip())
        return now - timedelta(days=days)
    elif 'm ago' in text:
        minutes = int(text.split('m')[0].strip())
        return now - timedelta(minutes=minutes)
    else:
        # Fallback: assume recent
        return now
```

### Calculate Engagement Rate

```python
def calculate_engagement_rate(likes, views):
    """
    Calculate engagement rate.
    
    Formula: (likes / views) * 100
    """
    if views == 0:
        return 0.0
    return (likes / views) * 100
```

---

## Error Handling

### Scenario A: Filter button not found

```python
try:
    crypto_button = page.locator('button:has-text("Crypto")')
    crypto_button.click()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Crypto filter not found: {e}")
    # Try alternative selector
    crypto_button = page.locator('.filter-crypto')
    crypto_button.click()
```

### Scenario B: Item extraction fails

```python
for item in items:
    try:
        # Extract data
        title = item.locator('.item-title').text_content()
        # ... more extraction
    except Exception as e:
        # Skip malformed item
        print(f"Skipping item: {e}")
        continue
```

### Scenario C: No items loaded

```python
items = page.locator('[data-testid="feed-item"]').all()

if len(items) == 0:
    # Retry with different selector
    items = page.locator('.feed-item').all()
    
if len(items) == 0:
    # Site might be down or structure changed
    raise Exception("No items found on thefeed.today")
```

---

## Testing

### Manual test

1. Open https://thefeed.today/ in browser
2. Click "Crypto" filter
3. Scroll 3 times
4. Inspect first item's HTML
5. Verify selectors match

### Automated test

```python
def test_extraction():
    """Test extraction on thefeed.today"""
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=False)
        page = browser.new_page()
        
        # Navigate
        page.goto("https://thefeed.today/")
        page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        
        # Apply filter
        page.locator('button:has-text("Crypto")').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        
        # Extract first item
        item = page.locator('[data-testid="feed-item"]').first
        title = item.locator('.item-title').text_content()
        
        print(f"First item: {title}")
        
        browser.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_extraction()
```

---

## Maintenance

**When to update this guide:**
- thefeed.today changes HTML structure
- Selectors stop working
- New features added (e.g., new filters)
- Extraction logic needs adjustment

**How to update:**
1. Inspect current HTML structure
2. Update selector reference
3. Test extraction
4. Update parsing helpers if needed
5. Document changes in this file

---

**Last updated:** 2026-05-19
```

## File 6: `x-news-brief/references/prioritization.md`

```markdown
# Reference — Prioritization Logic

Detailed explanation of 3-tier priority system for news selection.

---

## Overview

**Goal:** Select most important and interesting items from extracted news.

**Approach:** 3-tier priority system applied to both Crypto and Tech categories.

**Output:**
- Top stories: 2-5 items (flexible mix)
- Đáng đọc: 7-10 items (50/50 split)

---

## 3-Tier Priority System

### Tier 1: Breaking News (Highest Priority)

**Definition:** Items tagged "Breaking" on thefeed.today

**Characteristics:**
- Time-sensitive
- High impact
- Unexpected developments
- Regulatory announcements
- Major launches or failures
- Security incidents

**Selection rule:**
- **Always include** all Tier 1 items in top stories
- No view threshold required
- No engagement threshold required

**Examples:**
- "SEC approves Ethereum ETFs"
- "Binance settles with DOJ for $4.3B"
- "Solana network halts for 6 hours"
- "OpenAI announces GPT-5 release date"
- "Apple acquires AI startup for $2B"

**Why highest priority:**
- Readers need to know immediately
- Affects market/industry decisions
- Time-sensitive information

---

### Tier 2: High Engagement (Medium-High Priority)

**Definition:** Items with significant views and engagement

**Thresholds:**
-Tiếp tục file 6 (prioritization.md) từ chỗ dừng:

---

```markdown
**Thresholds:**
- Views > 5,000
- Engagement rate > 5%

**Characteristics:**
- Viral momentum
- Community interest
- Credible sources
- Substantive content
- Not just hype

**Selection rule:**
- Sort by views descending
- Include top items in "Top stories" (after Tier 1)
- Include remaining in "Đáng đọc"

**Examples:**
- "Vitalik proposes new EIP" (2.3M views, 8.5% engagement)
- "Claude launches sandboxes" (1.5M views, 12.3% engagement)
- "Solana fees drop 90%" (847K views, 15.2% engagement)

**Why medium-high priority:**
- Proven community interest
- Likely to be discussed
- Worth reader's time

---

### Tier 3: Narrative Shift (Medium Priority)

**Definition:** Items with lower views but interesting angles

**Characteristics:**
- Emerging topics
- New perspectives
- Credible but niche sources
- Early signals
- Contrarian takes

**Selection rule:**
- Sort by engagement rate (quality over quantity)
- Include in "Đáng đọc" for diversity
- Balance with Tier 2 items

**Examples:**
- "Unexpected take from major dev" (50K views, 18% engagement)
- "New protocol architecture proposal" (30K views, 22% engagement)
- "Emerging trend in AI agents" (80K views, 14% engagement)

**Why medium priority:**
- Early signal of trends
- Adds diversity to brief
- Helps readers stay ahead

---

## Selection Algorithm

### Top Stories (2-5 items, flexible mix)

**Step 1: Include all Tier 1 (Breaking)**
```python
top_stories = []
top_stories.extend(crypto_breaking)
top_stories.extend(tech_breaking)
```

**Step 2: Fill remaining slots with Tier 2 (High Engagement)**
```python
# Merge both categories, sort by views
all_high_engagement = crypto_tier2 + tech_tier2
all_high_engagement.sort(key=lambda x: x['views'], reverse=True)

remaining_slots = 5 - len(top_stories)
top_stories.extend(all_high_engagement[:remaining_slots])
```

**Step 3: Ensure minimum 2 stories**
```python
if len(top_stories) < 2:
    # Add from Tier 3 if needed
    all_narrative = crypto_tier3 + tech_tier3
    all_narrative.sort(key=lambda x: x['engagement_rate'], reverse=True)
    top_stories.extend(all_narrative[:2 - len(top_stories)])
```

**Result:** 2-5 stories, flexible mix, highest priority wins

---

### Đáng Đọc (7-10 items, 50/50 split)

**Step 1: Separate by category**
```python
crypto_dang_doc = []
tech_dang_doc = []
```

**Step 2: Add Tier 2 items not in top stories**
```python
# Crypto
crypto_dang_doc.extend([
    item for item in crypto_tier2
    if item not in top_stories
][:3])

# Tech
tech_dang_doc.extend([
    item for item in tech_tier2
    if item not in top_stories
][:3])
```

**Step 3: Add Tier 3 items for diversity**
```python
# Crypto
crypto_dang_doc.extend(crypto_tier3[:2])

# Tech
tech_dang_doc.extend(tech_tier3[:2])
```

**Step 4: Limit to 5 per category**
```python
crypto_dang_doc = crypto_dang_doc[:5]
tech_dang_doc = tech_dang_doc[:5]
```

**Step 5: Ensure total is 7-10**
```python
total = len(crypto_dang_doc) + len(tech_dang_doc)

if total < 7:
    # Add more from Tier 3
    needed = 7 - total
    extra_crypto = crypto_tier3[2:2 + needed // 2]
    extra_tech = tech_tier3[2:2 + (needed - len(extra_crypto))]
    crypto_dang_doc.extend(extra_crypto)
    tech_dang_doc.extend(extra_tech)
```

**Result:** 7-10 items, roughly 50/50 split

---

## Edge Cases

### Case 1: Many breaking items (>5)

**Scenario:** 7 breaking items across both categories

**Solution:**
- Include all breaking in top stories
- Expand top stories to 6-7 items
- Adjust đáng đọc accordingly

**Example:**
```
🔥 Top 7 stories (6 breaking)
• [Breaking 1]
• [Breaking 2]
• [Breaking 3]
• [Breaking 4]
• [Breaking 5]
• [Breaking 6]
• [High engagement 1]
```

---

### Case 2: One category has no Tier 1 or Tier 2

**Scenario:** Crypto has 0 breaking, 0 high engagement

**Solution:**
- Top stories: All from Tech (flexible mix)
- Đáng đọc: Use Tier 3 for Crypto, maintain 50/50

**Example:**
```
🔥 Top 4 stories (all Tech)
• [Tech breaking 1]
• [Tech breaking 2]
• [Tech high engagement 1]
• [Tech high engagement 2]

📌 Đáng đọc (8 items)

Crypto:
• [Tier 3 item 1] — Emerging topic
• [Tier 3 item 2] — Emerging topic
• [Tier 3 item 3] — Emerging topic
• [Tier 3 item 4] — Emerging topic

Tech:
• [Tier 2 item 1]
• [Tier 2 item 2]
• [Tier 2 item 3]
• [Tier 2 item 4]
```

---

### Case 3: Extreme imbalance (e.g., 20 crypto, 2 tech)

**Scenario:** Crypto has 20 new items, Tech has 2

**Solution:**
- Top stories: Flexible (likely more crypto)
- Đáng đọc: Adjust split (e.g., 7 crypto, 2 tech)
- Note imbalance in narrative pulse

**Example:**
```
🧠 Narrative pulse
Crypto: Major developments across DeFi, L2s, and regulation. 20 significant updates this session.
Tech: Quiet session with focus on developer tools. Limited major announcements.

📌 Đáng đọc (9 items)

Crypto:
• [7 items]

Tech:
• [2 items]
```

---

## Prioritization Helpers

### Calculate Priority Score

```python
def calculate_priority_score(item):
    """
    Calculate priority score for sorting.
    
    Score = (tier_weight * 1000) + (views / 1000) + (engagement_rate * 10)
    
    Tier weights:
    - Tier 1 (Breaking): 1000
    - Tier 2 (High engagement): 100
    - Tier 3 (Narrative): 10
    """
    if item['breaking']:
        tier_weight = 1000
    elif item['views'] > 5000 and item['engagement_rate'] > 5.0:
        tier_weight = 100
    else:
        tier_weight = 10
    
    score = (tier_weight * 1000) + (item['views'] / 1000) + (item['engagement_rate'] * 10)
    return score
```

### Explain Why Interesting

```python
def explain_why_interesting(item):
    """
    Generate 1-line explanation of why item is interesting.
    
    Returns:
        str: Brief explanation
    """
    if item['breaking']:
        return "Breaking news"
    elif item['engagement_rate'] > 15:
        return f"High engagement ({item['engagement_rate']:.1f}%)"
    elif item['views'] > 1_000_000:
        return "Viral momentum"
    elif item['views'] > 100_000:
        return "Strong interest"
    else:
        return "Emerging topic"
```

---

## Quality Filters

### Exclude Low-Quality Items

**Criteria for exclusion:**
- Views < 1,000 (too niche)
- Engagement rate < 1% (low interest)
- Duplicate content (same story, different source)
- Spam or promotional content
- Off-topic (not crypto/tech)

**Implementation:**
```python
def is_quality_item(item):
    """
    Check if item meets quality threshold.
    
    Returns:
        bool: True if quality, False otherwise
    """
    # Minimum thresholds
    if item['views'] < 1000:
        return False
    if item['engagement_rate'] < 1.0:
        return False
    
    # Spam detection (simple)
    spam_keywords = ['buy now', 'limited time', 'click here', 'free money']
    if any(keyword in item['title'].lower() for keyword in spam_keywords):
        return False
    
    return True
```

---

## Balancing Act

### Principles

1. **Breaking news always wins** — Tier 1 overrides all
2. **Engagement signals quality** — High views + high rate = valuable
3. **Diversity matters** — Include emerging topics (Tier 3)
4. **Category balance** — Maintain 50/50 in đáng đọc
5. **Flexibility over rigidity** — Adjust to actual news distribution

### Trade-offs

**Scenario:** 5 crypto breaking, 0 tech breaking

**Option A: Strict 50/50**
- Top stories: 3 crypto breaking, 2 tech high engagement
- Result: Misses important crypto breaking news

**Option B: Flexible (recommended)**
- Top stories: 5 crypto breaking
- Result: Reflects actual news importance

**Decision:** Option B (flexible) for top stories, maintain 50/50 for đáng đọc

---

## Testing Prioritization

### Test Cases

**Test 1: Normal distribution**
- Input: 10 crypto (2 breaking, 5 high engagement, 3 narrative)
- Input: 10 tech (1 breaking, 6 high engagement, 3 narrative)
- Expected: 3 breaking in top stories, 50/50 in đáng đọc

**Test 2: Extreme breaking**
- Input: 8 breaking total
- Expected: All 8 in top stories (expand limit)

**Test 3: One category empty**
- Input: 15 crypto, 0 tech
- Expected: Top stories all crypto, đáng đọc all crypto with note

**Test 4: Low engagement across board**
- Input: All items < 5K views
- Expected: Use Tier 3 (engagement rate) for selection

---

## Maintenance

**When to adjust thresholds:**
- Views threshold (currently 5K) if inflation/deflation
- Engagement rate threshold (currently 5%) if platform changes
- Tier weights if priority balance feels off

**How to adjust:**
1. Monitor brief quality over 1 week
2. Identify patterns (too much/little of X)
3. Adjust thresholds incrementally
4. Test for 3 days
5. Document changes in this file

---

**Last updated:** 2026-05-19
